items.headline: I built a plugin that automatically tracks and summarizes all your Claude Code sessions
items.summary: I kept losing track of what I worked on across different Claude Code sessions and projects. So I built Session Tracker - a Claude Code plugin that automatically captures every session, generates AI summaries using Haiku, and gives you a searchable web UI to browse your history. The plugin analyzes your conversation transcript incrementally and calls claude -p --model haiku to generate structured summaries. On session end, it consolidates everything into a final summary. Uses your subscript
